testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a duplicate view representation name ✔ Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active copied view is named "Capture View" ✔ And a sibling view is named "Front" ✔ When the user selects the copied view and presses F2 ✔ And the user replaces its name with "Front" and presses Enter ✔ Then a message says the new name is already used ✔ And the message offers Edit and cancels ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the active view is named "Capture View" ✔ And the View branch identifies "Capture View" as active
